title: A Guild of Our Own (miniquest)
start: Speak to Darren Lightfinger in his cellar accessed through a trapdoor north of Lumbridge furnace.

items.t: Any blackjack (not including the rubber blackjack)
Irit potion (unfinished) (or clean irit and a vial of water)

recommended.t: Ardougne teleport runes, tablet (recommended) or Ardougne lodestone.

rewards.t: Ability to mix vials of stench
If players take the vial of stench (a) from the quest back to Chief Thief Robin, he re-enchants it so players can sell stolen goods to shopkeepers as long as they have the potion in the backpack
rewards.l: Vial of stench (a) (A Guild of Our Own)

rewards.t: Full access to the Thieves' Guild, including a bank
Ability to obtain special items from cracking safes

steps.t: In a building south-east of Ardougne market, pickpocket the Registrar for a cuckoo clock key.
Get ready, the next steps are time sensitive. You can try again if you fail with no consequence. Make sure to equip a blackjack first.

sub.t: In the north room, wind the clock on the wall.
Go in the south room, wait for the Registrar to get to the clock room.
Lure, knock out, then steal-from the guard.
Pull the vault lever behind the desk.
Go down the trapdoor that opens, the following steps are no longer time sensitive.

p: Location of the clock, lever, and trapdoor

steps.t: Right-click pick-lock on the vault door.
Right-click check the chest for traps, then open it. You should receive some bonds.
Inspect the boxes under the square hole in the wall to exit. [Chat: 1 Leave the vault.]
Bank (recommended) or destroy your vial of stench (a).
Re-enter the building and talk to the Registrar.
Return to Darren Lightfinger. [Chat: 3 I'd like to talk about the caper I'm doing for you.]
